answers.core: I feel that something like this, considering it's so common and even the default in UI systems like ImGui and in operating systems like Windows, should probably be in the engine out of the box.
answers.workaround: As far as I am aware, and as seeing that the horizontal alignment of the title is hard-coded into the window node itself in the source code, I don't believe it is.

title: Allow changing the title's horizontal alignment for embedded Window nodes
